checks.description: Check nonempty output, minimal HTML shell and explicit stylesheet/module references, JSON and JavaScript syntax, and common literal local resource paths. Does not prove rendered content, event wiring, accessibility or visual quality.

Inspect 360px/1440px familiar Tailwind idiom and readable code/prices. Verify exact clipboard text after success, rejection/unavailable fallback, FAQ keyboard toggles, every local plan preview and no network actions.
checks.detail: manual is a human review cue and does not gate publication
